items: 【700% BREAKTHROUGH BRIGHTNESS】Upgrade your driving experience with our high-power light bulbs, featuring 12 high-power chips per light and an impressive 30,000LM brightness per set. With the latest Z10 technology, these headlights provide reliable and efficient illumination for optimal nighttime driving.

【UNMATCHED POWERFUL PERFORMANCE】Well-built premium aviation aluminum body, thermostatic copper plate, and an efficient cooling system to quickly cool the lights and ensure stable and continuous operation, extending the average life of each light to 50,000Hrs.

【NEW GENERATION CANBUS SYSTEM】Built-in more sophisticated CBNBUS driver, which is further optimized for some sensitive models, giving them a higher level of compatibility. In addition, we control the power of the lights between 50W and 65W, perfectly replacing the 55W and 60W halogen bulbs, eliminating the problem of flickering bulbs or triggering warnings on the dashboard.

【MOST PERFECT BEAM PATTERN】The lights precisely mimic the factory halogen bulbs, and after hundreds of tweaks and calibrations, achieved the best light pattern and clearer visibility. There are no dark spots or shadow areas, and no blinding or glare to oncoming drivers while driving, which greatly enhances safety.

【SMALLER SIZE & EASIER INSTALLATION】Unlike most bulbs on the market, our bulbs are optimized in appearance. Not only eliminating the external driver box and wires but also 20% smaller than other all-in-one lights, almost halogen bulbs 1:1 small size, which perfectly solves the problems that will be encountered during installation, such as dust cover issues.
